mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inbox_event (consumer_name, event_id, tenant_id, hotel_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_version, event_ordinal, event_type, schema_version, occurred_at, payload, outcome, detail, received_at, settled_at) VALUES (#{consumerName}, #{m.eventId}, #{m.tenantId}, #{m.hotelId}, #{m.aggregateType}, #{m.aggregateId}, #{m.aggregateVersion}, #{m.eventOrdinal}, #{m.eventType}, #{m.schemaVersion}, #{m.occurredAt}, #{m.payload}::jsonb, #{outcome}, #{detail}, now(), CASE WHEN #{outcome} = 'PARKED_GAP' THEN NULL ELSE now() END) ON CONFLICT (consumer_name, event_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO inbox_consumer_position (consumer_name, tenant_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, last_version, last_ordinal, updated_at) VALUES (#{consumerName}, #{tenantId}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{version}, #{ordinal}, now()) ON CONFLICT (consumer_name, tenant_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id) DO UPDATE SET last_ordinal = CASE WHEN excluded.last_version > inbox_consumer_position.last_version THEN excluded.last_ordinal WHEN excluded.last_version = inbox_consumer_position.last_version THEN GREATEST(excluded.last_ordinal, inbox_consumer_position.last_ordinal) ELSE inbox_consumer_position.last_ordinal END, last_version = GREATEST(excluded.last_version, inbox_consumer_position.last_version), updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT event_id, tenant_id, hotel_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_version, event_ordinal, event_type, schema_version, payload::text AS payload, occurred_at FROM inbox_event WHERE consumer_name = #{consumerName} AND outcome = 'PARKED_GAP' ORDER BY aggregate_id, aggregate_version, event_ordinal LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE inbox_event SET outcome = #{outcome}, detail = #{detail}, settled_at = now() WHERE consumer_name = #{consumerName} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND outcome = 'PARKED_GAP'
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM inbox_event WHERE consumer_name = #{consumerName} AND outcome = 'PARKED_GAP'
